tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a damped fast transient at a long forecast horizon. A trajectory batch can distinguish transient and slow dynamics that the five long-horizon observations leave ambiguous.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary slow-relaxation or Kelvin–Voigt model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations confound input and history variables and do not identify the transient mechanism reliably.
It is not targeted at resolving the temporal mechanism.
